articles.title: More weather records as UK heat set to spike again

articles.title: UK to get best eclipse since 1999 as Moon blocks out Sun across Europe
articles.description: Up to 96% of the Sun will be covered by the Moon in the UK, while parts of Spain, Greenland, Iceland, Portugal and Russia will see a total eclipse.

articles.title: Rangers' Chermiti out for 'significant period' with ACL injury

articles.title: AI agent hacks gym to get its user a spot in pilates class
